Definition: a goblet (as deep like a cover)
BiblicalUsage: Jerusalem has drunk at the hand of the LORD the cup of his fury, the dregs of the cup of trembling, and wrung them out. Then God says, behold, I have taken it out of thine hand; thou shalt no more drink it again. The word is the goblet itself.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God takes the cup of trembling out of Jerusalem's hand himself, and the dregs are not drunk twice.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
